notes: Used almost exclusively in the plural (pluralia tantum), unlike the uncountable singular English 'pasta'.
Covers all shapes of pasta. In everyday speech, Greeks very often say 'τα μακαρόνια' for pasta in general, while 'τα ζυμαρικά' is more common on menus and packaging.
